title: Ambient alpha-compact triangulated class in a Grothendieck derived category
statement: For an essentially v-small class P in the derived category of a Grothendieck abelian category, there are an object property S and a regular cardinal alpha in universe v such that S is essentially v-small, replete and triangulated, contains P, is closed under coproducts indexed by types of cardinality less than alpha, and every object of S is alpha-presentable.

source.place: Ambient well-generation and common cardinal bound: Neeman Theorem 0.2; Krause Localization theory Sections 6.2-6.3.

proof.text: Apply the alpha-compact class core theorem to obtain S and a regular cardinal α. Its equivalence identifies S with α-presentable objects, while its remaining clauses provide essential smallness, repleteness, triangulated closure and closure under coproducts of fewer than α summands. The final clause gives P ≤ S because every object of P is α-presentable.

proof_origin.place: Unpack the alpha-compact class core and use its P-presentability clause.

theorem derived_exists_perfectSmallClass_core
    {A : Type u} [Category.{v} A] [Abelian A]
    [IsGrothendieckAbelian.{v} A] [HasDerivedCategory.{v} A]
    (P : ObjectProperty (DerivedCategory A))
    [ObjectProperty.EssentiallySmall.{v} P] :
    ∃ (S : ObjectProperty (DerivedCategory A)) (α : Cardinal.{v})
      (_ : Fact α.IsRegular),
      ObjectProperty.EssentiallySmall.{v} S ∧ S.IsClosedUnderIsomorphisms ∧
      S.IsTriangulated ∧ P ≤ S ∧ (∀ (I : Type v) (Y : I → DerivedCategory A),
        HasCardinalLT I α → (∀ i, S (Y i)) → S (∐ Y)) ∧
      ∀ U, S U → IsCardinalPresentable U α
